codes.ERR_DELIVERY_UNRESOLVED_REF: A deployment's @app or @environment, or a value.ref's @producedBy, names no node, or names a node of the wrong kind (@app takes an app.*, @environment an environment.*, @producedBy a resource.* or an app.*).
codes.ERR_DELIVERY_DUPLICATE_SETTING: A deployment holds two value.* nodes for one @setting. An estate overlay that overrides a value must reuse the value node's name so it merges.
codes.ERR_DELIVERY_DUPLICATE_DEPLOYMENT: Two deployments target the same (@app, @environment), compared as resolved nodes.
